name: prompt-corrector
description: Fixes the typos in your prompt before it is sent, leaving code, paths, URLs, commands and identifiers as typed: Jev spots the prompts with mistakes, Haiku corrects them, you send or edit the result.

jevApiKey.title: Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: Your TypeSafe API key, which Jev uses to tell whether a prompt has mistakes.

threshold.title: Mistake threshold
threshold.description: How sure Jev must be that a prompt has mistakes before Haiku corrects it, from 0 to 1.
